review_requests.description: Recipients for authorized review or re-review requests at PR fix finalization. Null asks dk-pr-approvers to discover appropriate recipients; two empty lists disable automatic requests. Explicit request recipients take precedence.

reviewers.description: GitHub usernames without @, not numeric account IDs.

team_reviewers.description: Repository organization team slugs without an organization prefix.

default_merge_method.description: Fallback method for an already authorized concrete merge request that omits its method. All live guards still apply.
